title: Connecting spatial regions to clinical phenotypes by transferring knowledge from bulk gene expression data.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology

snippet: Understanding intra-tumor heterogeneity is a key step towards understanding cancer. Spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) technology allows for estimation of transcriptional variability, cell types, and spatial relations between locations in a 2D tissue slice.
